integrity: The stated theorem is analytically proved and supplemented by finite reproducibility checks; finite checks do not certify its infinite-dimensional quantifiers. Relevant prior derivative and boundary calculations are credited. Independent validation and independent audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the bivariate correlation-clipped Bernoulli operator copula. The parameter is not the Pearson correlation of the continuous pair. It does not furnish multidimensional claims or a universal estimator; independent priority validation is outstanding.
title: Exact singular mass and conditional atoms of the clipped Bernoulli-correlation copula
